title: Resident Work Delegation and Handoff Runtime

staged_artifacts.purpose: Isolated delegation and handoff state machine with authority metadata, evidence, idempotent retry, ownership transfer, and receipt contracts.
Focused staged coverage for deterministic states, authorized ownership transfer, visibility, receipts, and idempotency.
Staged workstream overview and shared-file isolation boundary.

intended_install_paths.install_mode: new active runtime module or merge into selected assignment/work-package runtime module
adapt imports from staged module to active module

files_expected_to_change_during_wp_4031_: Dispatch and Traffic Controller integration points
active_files_not_modified_by_this_stage: Dispatch and Traffic Controller integration points
install_steps: Review active assignment, work-package, Dispatch, Traffic Controller, mailbox, audit, and Office surfaces for conflict windows.
Install or merge the staged runtime into the selected active runtime module without creating a second queue, assignment registry, Dispatch path, or authority layer.
Map AuthorityMetadata fields to existing source authority and approval systems; do not treat delegated messages as authority.
Wire delegation requests through existing assignment/work-package records and existing mailbox/Dispatch visibility mechanisms.
Persist handoff receipts through existing audit and provenance mechanisms while preserving evidence references.
Adapt staged tests into active tests and run focused plus affected assignment, Dispatch, mailbox, audit, Office, and CLI tests.

acceptance_checks: Delegation states are deterministic for the same state, actor, authority metadata, and idempotency key.
Ownership cannot change without an authorized transfer transition.
Rejected and stalled work remains visible through existing active surfaces.
Completion receipts preserve evidence and provenance.
Idempotent retries do not duplicate history, receipts, or ownership changes.
Source authority and approval metadata are caller-provided from existing mechanisms.

dependencies: Existing assignment and work-package runtime records for work item identity and ownership persistence.
Existing Traffic Controller and Dispatch paths for routing and visibility.
Existing mailbox mechanisms for resident notification and handoff messages.
Existing audit mechanisms for receipt persistence and provenance.
Existing authority and approval mechanisms for transition authorization.
rollback: Remove installed resident delegation runtime module or revert merged active runtime changes.
Revert assignment, Dispatch, Traffic Controller, Office, mailbox, and audit wiring from WP-4031.
Remove active tests adapted from WP-4023 staged tests.
Re-run the affected assignment, work-package, CLI, Office, mailbox, audit, and Dispatch test subset.
